job.title: Software Engineer, Web, Government Products
job.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
job.pay_full: $166,000 – $195,000 a year base pay (Zone 1: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC), plus bonus opportunities, equity and benefits

details.about: Robinhood has been chosen as the brokerage and initial trustee for Government Products, working with BNY and the U.S. Department of the Treasury to build and run a program that aims to expand market access for the next generation of Americans. The Government Products team builds and scales systems for long-term investing and account management for millions of customers. This web engineer joins a 0-to-1 effort to build the polished, reliable, accessible web experience families will use to open and manage accounts, and helps set the patterns of a brand-new front-end codebase.
duties: Build, test and ship web features with React and modern JavaScript for a new standalone product built for security, reliability and scale
Work with Product, Design and backend engineers to turn requirements into intuitive, accessible customer experiences
Integrate the front end with the backend-for-frontend layer and the services behind it
Contribute to front-end architecture, reusable components and engineering best practices for the new codebase
Take part in code reviews and help keep quality, performance and accessibility high
needs: Experience building production web applications with React and modern JavaScript, focused on performance, accessibility and a polished experience
Comfort working with APIs and with backend engineers on end-to-end features
Willingness to learn quickly and handle ambiguity in a zero-to-one product
A habit of clean, well-tested code and a desire to learn from feedback
Clear communication and close partnership with Product, Design and other teams
nice: Experience with financial products or investment technology
details.benefits: Base pay $166,000 – $195,000 a year in Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC); the posting also lists $147,000 – $172,000 for Zone 2 and $130,000 – $152,000 for Zone 3. The role is eligible for bonus opportunities and equity. Robinhood offers performance-driven pay, bonus programs, equity ownership and 401(k) matching; 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents; a flexible lifestyle wallet for wellness and learning; employer-paid life and disability insurance, fertility and mental health benefits; company holidays, paid time off, sick time and parental leave; and catered meals and events in the office.
notes: Based in the New York and Menlo Park offices, in person 3 days a week
Restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents
Candidates may submit no more than 3 applications in 90 days, and apply to each role only once

lines: Welcome to Veritas Recruitment Agency, where we bring you real tech jobs straight from employers' own careers sites.

Working with BNY and the U.S. Treasury

The team builds systems for long-term investing and account management for millions of customers.

This is a 0-to-1 project: you'll build the web experience families use to open and manage accounts, and help set the patterns of a brand-new front-end codebase.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Ship web features in React & modern JavaScript
lines: You'll build, test, and ship web features in React and modern JavaScript for a new product built for security, reliability, and scale.
You'll work closely with product, design, and backend engineers, and connect the front end to the backend-for-frontend layer.
You'll also help shape the front-end architecture and reusable components, and keep quality, performance, and accessibility high through code reviews.

scenes.head: What you need
lines: You'll need experience building production web apps with React and modern JavaScript, with a focus on performance, accessibility, and a polished experience.
You should be comfortable working with APIs, quick to learn in an ambiguous new product, and in the habit of writing clean, well-tested code.
Clear communication matters, and experience with financial or investing products is a plus.

scenes.head: Pay & benefits
lines: Base pay in Menlo Park and New York is one hundred sixty-six thousand to one hundred ninety-five thousand dollars a year, plus bonus opportunities and equity.
Benefits include four-oh-one-k matching, fully paid health insurance for employees with ninety percent coverage for dependents, a flexible lifestyle wallet, paid time off, and parental leave.
The role is in the office three days a week, and it's open to U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents.
